translation:
Hey, Haruhi, there's been something about
your behavior I've often wondered about.
Hm? Which part?

You're far more strict with me compared to
the other SOS Brigade members, aren't you?

What are you talking about Kyon?
That's kind of a strange thing to say.

When have I ever thought little of you? Tell
me.

It always feels like you're working me hard—
making me do all sorts of chores and whatnot.

Actually, you're definitely working me to the
bone!

That's just because that kind of work is a
perfect fit for you. Isn't that right?

Anyway, even doing chores is respectable
work. Someone has to get them done, after all.
Be that as it may… why does it have to be me?
What? You still got a problem with it?

Then you'd better up your game as a member
of the SOS Brigade.
I won't hear any complaints until you do.

If you can do that much, then I might actually
listen. Just listening is all I'll promise, though.

In other words, you just don't feel like
listening to me in the first place, do you…
Despite everything you say, Suzumiya…
…you do rely on Kyon a fair amount.
Huh?!

Mikuru, why the heck are you saying that all
of a sudden?!

B-but you always seem to care about him and
stuff…
Listen here, Mikuru. You've got it all wrong.

Sure, I keep a close eye on what he's getting
up to—I'll give you that.

But that's purely supervision, okay?
Supervision!!

He's unmotivated and lacking in guts.
Not to mention his rampant pessimism.

Despite the fact that he was hand-picked to
be a member of our prestigious SOS Brigade…
Absolutely pathetic!

Well, maybe it's just a matter of
circumstance…
But Kyon is a part of the SOS Brigade.
To put it simply—as the brigade chief…
It's my responsibility to supervise Kyon!
You got that Mikuru?!
Y-yes. I understand how you feel about Kyon.
Ughh… I get the feeling you still don't get it.
You know what, Mikuru? Sit down over here.

I need you to understand just a little bit
more.
Huh?! Y-you mean now?
When else do you think? Now means now.
Ehhhh! P-please nooo!

I have been considering your relationship with
him.
Huh? Yuki, what do you mean, "relationship”?

It is difficult to view your correspondence
with him as…
…fully amiable.

But depending on the circumstance, I sense a
trust that you don't have in other humans.
Yuki, I think you're misunderstanding.

In a way, I'm sort of like Kyon's guardian, you
know?

He's unmotivated and always tries to take
the easy way out of things…
I'm just educating him.

Kyon's position in the SOS Brigade is like an
apprentice or trainee.
So it's guidance—what he needs is guidance.

If the way I treat Kyon seems rough
sometimes, then that's definitely why.
So? Understood?
Understood.

Miss Suzumiya, you seem to always give him a
heavy workload, wouldn't you say?

Who, Kyon? I'm not exactly going out of my
way to give him tons of work or anything.

The only things I can trust him with are odd
jobs.

Odd jobs they may be—he's always the one
who ends up being entrusted with those things.

Therefore, he must be of importance to the
SOS Brigade and, by consequence, to you.
Well, I guess you could look at it that way.
But still, he complains at every opportunity.

Always acting like everything's a massive
bother.

So I'm just correcting that withered
determination of his.
It's sort of like that, I guess.

I see. So in a sense, you're like his guardian,
right?
Yes! That's it!

I'm kind of like Kyon's guardian, or teacher,
or coach, or…
Well whatever you call it, that sort of thing!
That's our Koizumi, landing the bullseye.
I'm honored to receive such praise.
